extraction.name: EgoLife Dataset
extraction.description: A comprehensive 300-hour egocentric daily life dataset collected from six participants living together for one week, with multimodal egocentric video, synchronized third-person views, and intensive annotations. It supports studying long-duration activities, interpersonal dynamics, and contextual interactions.
extraction.creator: The EgoLife Team
extraction.rai:dataCollection: A comprehensive physical data collection study in which six participants lived together for one week in a fully instrumented living environment, continuously recording daily activities with AI glasses for multimodal egocentric video capture, supplemented by synchronized third-person cameras and mmWave devices.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Egocentric multimodal video recorded with Meta Aria glasses, synchronized third-person perspectives from 15 additional cameras, and data from two mmWave devices.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Transcript annotations were created by applying speech recognition to merged audio, using diarization to separate speakers, then having reviewers refine transcripts per participant to keep only audible speech. Caption annotations used a video editing/dubbing tool on 5-minute clips slowed to 0.8×, where annotators continuously narrated actions, interactions, and environment details; these narrations were transcribed, reviewed, corrected, merged into coherent captions, expanded with frames and transcripts via GPT-4o, and then verified by human annotators. QA annotations used five designed question types and prompts; GPT-4o generated candidate timestamped questions from visual-audio captions, which annotators reviewed in sync with video, filtered for long-context relevance, refined, added distractors for multiple-choice format, and annotated audio requirement and look-back time.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: A video editing software with dubbing functions was used for caption annotation.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The paper describes review, correction, verification, and rigorous selection/refinement of annotations, but does not report formal agreement metrics. Transcript and caption annotations were reviewed for accuracy, visual-audio captions were verified by human annotators, and QA candidates were filtered from about 100K to 1K and then to 500 per participant through rigorous selection and meticulous revision.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Speech recognition, an open-source diarization algorithm, a transcription tool, GPT-4o-mini, and GPT-4o were used to assist annotation. GPT-4o-mini merged narration phrases into captions; GPT-4o expanded captions and generated QA candidates.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The paper states that current egocentric datasets are limited by short recording durations and mostly single-person perspectives, which motivates EgoLife; it also notes the current evaluation is only a quick evaluation on one participant's 500 QA, and that the dataset currently needs expansion to broader languages, locations, and activities.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset is framed as enabling AI assistants that enhance personal and interpersonal efficiency, provide meaningful life-oriented assistance, and potentially become efficient, empathetic companions that enrich everyday life.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset contains recordings of participants' daily activities and social interactions, including discussions, shopping, cooking, socializing, entertainment, health habits, and multimodal audio/video data tied to identity recognition and personalized recommendations.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended for research on egocentric AI assistants, ultra-long egocentric video understanding, multimodal video understanding, identity recognition and tracking, long-context question answering, analysis of long-duration activities, interpersonal dynamics, contextual interactions, habit discovery, and relational interaction pattern analysis. It is also used for training/fine-tuning and evaluation of systems such as EgoGPT, EgoRAG, EgoButler, and the EgoLifeQA benchmark.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The authors state they will release the datasets, models, and benchmarks, and plan future expansion of the dataset to broader languages, locations, and activities. No explicit versioning schedule or deprecation policy is provided.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: A rigorous data cleaning process was implemented to ensure synchronization, participant privacy, and readiness for annotation and data release.

rai:dataAnnotationProtocol.evidence: “applying speech recognition [90] to generate initial timestamped transcripts... Using an open-source diarization algorithm [91]... This 50-hour transcript was then reviewed for accuracy... Reviewers refined each track”; “We split all the videos into 5-minute clips, which were slowed to 0.8× speed, allowing annotators to provide continuous, detailed narrations”; “The narration was converted to text via a transcription tool, then reviewed and corrected”; “verified by human annotators”; “For QA annotation, we designed five types of questions... We crafted prompts for each type and fed ‘visual-audio captions’ into GPT-4o... These AI-generated questions were provided to annotators... Annotators also generated distractors... annotated whether audio was required... and specified the look-back time”
